body:
Tested locally, it mostly works as expected.

The main issue I noticed is that when you click a resource that can't be located (such as internal render targets), the FileSystem dock will be focused but no file will be selected. An error message will also be printed:

```
ERROR: Cannot navigate to 'Render Target (Internal)' as it has not been found in the file system!
   at: _navigate_to_path (./editor/filesystem_dock.cpp:719)
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/31d2724e-c267-4b82-901a-3e23a138861e

Instead, it shouldn't focus the FileSystem dock and nothing should happen if the file doesn't exist on disk.

(This also happens for paths to built-in resources like `res://coin/coin.tscn::GradientTexture2D_qhu5r`, so it's not limited to render textures.)

Works great now :slightly_smiling_face: 

Code looks good to me.
